operational_rule: Objective ocular/oral involvement; ESSDAI <5; no current organ-threatening feature
rule_type: Proposed composite using sourced activity boundary
overlap_rule: May overlap SEG-02; may carry refractory/biomarker/lymphoma flags
clinical_variables: ESSDAI domains; ESSPRI components; UWS/SWS separately; Schirmer/ocular staining
trial_use: Glandular function plus patient-reported benefit; protocol-specific reserve requirement
commercial_relevance: Symptom burden may motivate development; intensive-treatment suitability requires separate evidence
caveat: Low activity does not prove absence of damage or early disease

segment_name: High symptom burden / low systemic activity
operational_rule: ESSDAI <5 and ESSPRI ≥5; retain dryness/pain/fatigue components
overlap_rule: May overlap SEG-01; fatigue/pain alone do not imply B-cell-driven activity
clinical_variables: ESSDAI; ESSPRI; comorbidity and alternative symptom attribution
trial_use: Patient-reported endpoint enrichment; objective function separately
commercial_relevance: Unmet need hypothesis; no assumed advanced-therapy eligible fraction
caveat: High ESSPRI is not high systemic activity

operational_rule: ESSDAI 5–13; list active domains and attribution
rule_type: Sourced activity band plus proposed operational recording
overlap_rule: Can overlap biomarker/refractory flags; no lymphoma-risk substitution
clinical_variables: ESSDAI total/domain; organ-specific function; ESSPRI separately
trial_use: Systemic trial population; actual eligibility from each protocol
caveat: Biological/glandular domain contribution alone does not establish organ threat

operational_rule: ESSDAI ≥14; list active domains and attribution
rule_type: Sourced activity band plus proposed operational recording
overlap_rule: May overlap SEG-05; high total does not automatically mean organ-threatening
clinical_variables: ESSDAI total/domain; organ function; damage; safety context
trial_use: High-activity stratum; preserve baseline treatment and follow-up
commercial_relevance: High need hypothesis; safety and reachability may reduce opportunity
caveat: Total activity and organ-specific severity remain distinct

operational_rule: Named active Sjögren-attributed organ manifestation with documented threat to function/life; specialist or protocol adjudication
rule_type: Analyst operational proposal; no universal numerical cutoff
overlap_rule: Overlay on SEG-03/04 or other scores when organ evidence warrants; not a score-only bin
clinical_variables: Organ diagnosis; severity; active inflammation versus damage; ESSDAI domain; current therapy
trial_use: Organ-specific benefit and rescue rules; safety assessment
caveat: Examples such as active pulmonary/renal/neurological disease require case-specific verification; no patient treatment recommendation

segment_name: Low systemic activity without documented glandular predominance
operational_rule: ESSDAI <5; adequate glandular evaluation does not meet SEG-01 rule
overlap_rule: May overlap SEG-02; missing glandular data belongs in SEG-07 instead
clinical_variables: ESSDAI; ESSPRI; glandular assessment; previous organ history
trial_use: Residual low-activity population prevents forced sicca assignment
commercial_relevance: Separate from assumed therapy eligible population
caveat: Inactive disease and historical damage require separate recording

operational_rule: Required activity, glandular or organ-threat evaluation unavailable
overlap_rule: Retain known tags; never impute missing score as zero
clinical_variables: Known measures plus reason for missingness
commercial_relevance: No inferred fraction or advanced-therapy eligibility
caveat: Use not_reported/not_studied/not_evaluable at underlying field level

operational_rule: Record coexisting autoimmune disease; source definition and attribution separately
overlap_rule: Exclude from primary core denominator; allow explicit contextual comparisons
clinical_variables: Underlying disease; Sjögren evidence; classification system; organ attribution
commercial_relevance: Separate opportunity; do not pool or transfer primary estimates
caveat: Unclear primary/associated attribution is an unresolved population stratum

operational_rule: Source-estimated undiagnosed disease or suspected sicca; distinguish these two states
rule_type: Charter funnel stratum; not a clinical trial segment
overlap_rule: Outside diagnosed core; suspicion alone does not count as confirmed disease
clinical_variables: Source case definition; diagnosis pathway; classification evidence
trial_use: Not current treatment-eligible denominator without diagnosis and protocol assessment
caveat: No prevalence or conversion rate supplied; many causes of sicca are not Sjögren
